android.desc:
- Please allow Notifications permission to allow the app to keep the volume locked even when the app is closed

- App only locks MEDIA and RINGTONE volume. It DOES NOT work for Alarm or any other type of volume.

- Lock MEDIA and/or RINGTONE VOLUME to a certain level in app and as soon as your MEDIA and/or RINGTONE VOLUME is changed, app will react almost instantly and set it back to the configured level in less than a second.

- Children play games on high MEDIA volume and as a parent you get annoyed. This app helps you lock your MEDIA volume to a certain level so your child cannot increase the volume.

- Don't worry about unintentionally increasing/decreasing the MEDIA and/or RINGTONE volume. Lock your MEDIA and/or RINGTONE volume to a certain level within app and let it keep your MEDIA and/or RINGTONE volume to that level all the time.

- No more accidental volume changes because app will react fast to any MEDIA and RINGTONE volume change and will set the volume back to what you have configured in app.
